name: Giant Octopus
publication: DDEX1-11 - Dark Pyramid of Sorcerer's Isle
sourceWitness: Visually checked the local original Adventurers League against its colophon and printed folios.

name: Boar

sourceNotes: The p. 12 breakout attack is printed separately from the p. 28 Boar’s ordinary Tusk. The enhanced attack applies in the stated breakout sequence. The adventure describes an ordinary boar without distinctive anatomy.
